# `gmin` control -- generated, do not edit

Generated by `sim/bias-core-startup/control/run_gmin_control.py`. Re-run it to
regenerate this file, the two decks under `decks/` and the two raw ngspice logs
under `logs/`. The numbers quoted in `design/bias_core.md`,
`../testbench/stimulus.spice` and `../testbench/tb.json` are transcribed from
here, and from nowhere else.

One variable: `.options gmin`. Both decks are composed from
`gmin_control.spice` + `design/netlist/bias_core.spice` in the same process,
at tt / -40 C / VDD = 3.3 V, plain `op`.

## Result

| | ngspice default (`gmin = 1e-12`) | the superseded deck (`gmin = 1e-9`) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `V(NOKO)` -- settle comparator output | 1.643330117 V | 0.6049341659 V |
| `V(NOKL)` -- its diode-load reference | 0.6015314242 V | 0.6261466422 V |
| `V(NOKX)` -- threshold-stage output | 94.44 uV | 3.256205666 V |
| `BIAS_OK` -- the flag | 3.29999985 V | 1.54 uV |
| `VREF` -- the reference | 1.19779105 V | 1.212109075 V |
| `I(XMOKA)` -- input pair, gate NA | 4.728 nA | 7.799 nA |
| `I(XMOKB)` -- input pair, gate NBTOP | 4.481 nA | 7.247 nA |
| `I(XMOL1)` -- diode load, mirrors XMOKB | 4.483 nA | 9.295 nA |
| `I(XMOL2)` -- mirror output, loads XMOKA | 4.727 nA | 9.284 nA |

Currents are the internal `m0` drain currents of the PDK FET subcircuits
(`@m.xdut.<inst>.m0[id]`), signed as ngspice reports them; the pFET pair reads
positive here because `id` is taken at the drain terminal into the device.

## What the numbers say

- The comparator's real signal is `I(XMOKA) - I(XMOKB)` = **+0.247 nA** at
  the default `gmin`, between two branches of ~4.7 nA. There the diode loads
  carry what the pair delivers to three digits (excess of +0.0021 nA on
  `NOKL`, -0.0017 nA on `NOKO`), so the comparator sees only its own signal
  and `NOKO` resolves high.
- At `gmin = 1e-9` the loads carry **2.048 nA** and **1.485 nA** more than
  the pair delivers. The **0.563 nA** difference between those two excesses
  is the unbalanced part: `XMOKC`'s drain junction hangs on `NOKO` with no
  counterpart on `NOKL` (`V(NOKO)` x 1 nS = 0.605 nA). It exceeds the 0.552
  nA the pair delivers at that perturbed operating point, and is more than
  twice the 0.247 nA of real signal at the true one, so the comparator lands
  on the wrong side.
- `VREF` moves +1.2 % between the two columns: the same aid acting on the
  main loop.
